answer: Running a farm therefore buys partial influence at full price for each duplicate self, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. Because the fable weight is recomputed from the thread history each close, the atlas audit exposes the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. A new identity spends its first 2 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 27% of full weight. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
